set: A: the page at rest, its result, and eight of the keys, as a web page

issues.where: the three perk cards, below their divider lines; same treatment in set-A-02.png
issues.what: At rest the visible rules carve out a large blank zone, so otherwise finished cards look like they are still waiting for content. The punchlines in set-A-05.png explain the space, but nothing in the resting layout does.
issues.fix: Make the reserved area look deliberately closed with a small labeled disclosure, or show the punchlines by default when motion is unavailable.

issues.where: the avatar and name area at the top of each testimonial card
issues.what: The identical gray square and two bars read as a loading skeleton before they read as intentional anonymity, weakening the illusion of a finished website.
issues.fix: Use an intentional redaction treatment such as a stamped NAME WITHHELD and a distinct anonymous avatar while preserving the card grid.

issues.where: the rightmost column next to Remote Friendly and Amazing Culture
issues.what: The vertically centered Still interested? paragraph sits without a heading or action in what otherwise reads as the slot for a third card.
issues.fix: Either treat the paragraph as the section's conclusion below the grid, or align it to the cards and give it a useful next action.
